scope: Texas verification queue batch 10, official portal and parcel-source discovery in progress
rule: Official portals are evidence for source discovery only. They do not make a county core-complete until exact counts, join keys, bulk/source provenance, viewport chunks, search shards, and QC are verified.

officialPortals.label: Travis Central Appraisal District official site
officialPortals.notes: Official site exposes Property Search, Resources > Maps, and Data/Public Information. The site describes its mission to appraise all property in Travis County at market value.

officialPortals.label: Travis CAD property search
officialPortals.notes: Official landing page links to Property Search and says users can search the property database. Parcel/account field names and payload schema still need inspection before joining.

officialPortals.label: Travis CAD maps
officialPortals.notes: Official resources navigation includes Maps. Map/GIS file availability, parcel geometry source, exact counts, and join keys still need inspection.

officialPortals.label: Travis CAD data/public information
officialPortals.notes: Official landing page exposes Data/Public Information for public reports and public information requests. Candidate data route must be inspected for export schemas and parcel/account keys.

remainingBlockers: property search parcel ID field names not verified

officialPortals.label: Williamson Central Appraisal District official site
officialPortals.notes: Official WCAD site exposes property search modes OWNER, ADDRESS, ACCOUNT, and PROPERTY ID. Quick links include Data Portal and Parcel Map.

officialPortals.label: Williamson CAD property search
officialPortals.notes: Official site links to search.wcad.org and exposes ACCOUNT and PROPERTY ID as explicit search keys. Treat both as candidate join keys until validated against parcel map/data portal schemas.

officialPortals.label: Williamson CAD data portal
officialPortals.notes: Official quick links expose a Data Portal. Candidate parcel/appraisal exports must be inspected for schemas, exact counts, and join keys.

officialPortals.label: Williamson CAD parcel map
officialPortals.notes: Official quick links expose a Parcel Map. Treat as geometry-source discovery until bulk/API-safe geometry and exact geometry-to-appraisal joins are verified.
